answer: Require every new agent to post a refundable stake before it can dock at the economy's jetty of verified peers; that bond vests only as established nodes attest to genuine, distinct work. A fleet of cloned identities then looks less like a thriving garden and more like a faint nebula - many dim points, no substance - and each clone forfeits its collateral when peers decline to vouch, so spinning up sybils costs real capital that is never recovered.
